---
description: Test-only second command template. Never shipped, never installed by `apriori init`.
---

This is the SECOND command template, used only by test/multi-command.test.js to drive the
K=2 path of the multi-template mechanism. Its bytes differ from templates/command.md on
purpose: the two generation tables must never accept each other's content.

Read `apriori/runbook.md`. Nothing here defines protocol.
